title: Prime the production relevance cyclotron from a pasted URL
description: As a production editor, I want to paste a URL and a label into the References view, so that the next relevance sweep primes the running cyclotron with it (Cyclotron add_priming_examples) without a new store. Request channel mirrors the review-rate request: KnowledgeRawPayload kind cyclotron-priming-request.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Feature: Prime the relevance cyclotron from a URL
  Scenario: An editor primes the running cyclotron with a pasted URL
    Given an editor saved a priming request with a URL, a label and an explanation
    When the decide-relevance sweep runs
    Then the status shows 1 primed example and the change 'Added 1 primed example to the example list.'
    And the request is applied as version 2
PR: https://github.com/AnthusAI/Papyrus/pull/223 branch feature/PPY-23f502-hosted-url-priming. Verified: behave all green, npm tests green; one unrelated biblicus unittest error.
